services.description: Zhipu's mainland-China developer platform for its own model family, with tuning, batch, and private instance deployment.
services.service_boundary: Represents the mainland platform operated at bigmodel.cn by a Chinese entity, not the separately operated Z.ai Model API, the open-weight model releases, or Zhipu's consumer assistant.
services.regional_controls: One public endpoint with no customer-selectable region. The privacy policy states that personal information collected in mainland operations is stored in mainland China with no current cross-border transfer. Private instances add virtual-network and allowlist access control.
services.retention_controls: Customers own uploaded data and the platform commits to no unauthorised use or disclosure and to minimum-necessary storage. Customer-initiated deletion triggers a product-specific buffer period after which caches and backups are removed irreversibly. There is no blanket commitment against training: anonymised data may be used for machine-learning and model-algorithm training without separate consent.
services.routing: Customers select a model identifier. Rate limiting is concurrency-based per model and tiered by benefit level and subscription, adjusted dynamically at peak. No cross-provider routing or documented fallback.
services.customization: Fine-tuning and evaluation are documented, with private instance deployment of tuned versions and configurable inference settings. Customer-supplied weights are not documented.
strengths: Compatible surfaces for two major client conventions sit alongside the native interface on one documented host.
Deletion is specified concretely as a buffer period followed by irreversible removal of cached and backup copies.
Personal information from mainland operations is stated to stay in mainland China with no current cross-border transfer.
tradeoffs: No blanket commitment against training; anonymised data may be used for model-algorithm training without separate consent.

The service agreement carries no date or version, unlike the user agreement and privacy policy.

services.operator: 上海七牛信息技术有限公司 (Shanghai Qiniu Information Technology)
services.description: A Chinese cloud operator's unified API routing to third-party and open-weight models, with separate mainland and overseas endpoints.
services.service_boundary: Represents the operator's model-inference API, offered under a separate overseas brand at a second endpoint, not the publishers whose models it routes to and not the operator's storage, delivery, or private GPU products.
services.regional_controls: Two endpoints are documented, one for mainland users and one overseas, over a network spanning several regions. The operator explicitly warns that the entry endpoint does not determine where a model executes, so no residency guarantee follows from endpoint choice.
services.retention_controls: Request logs hold metadata rather than content and are retained about thirty days with export interfaces. Retention of prompts and outputs is not documented: the user agreement defers to an artificial-intelligence data policy that is not published, in which case data is deleted when the service terminates. No zero-retention mode or opt-out is documented, and no clause grants training rights.
services.routing: A unified interface selects an upstream channel per request and adapts protocols to it. Third-party suppliers are onboarded through a formal admission programme.
services.customization: No fine-tuning or distillation is documented. Available controls are operational: per-key model scoping, per-key quotas, and prompt-cache control.
strengths: A dedicated service-level agreement with a published compensation schedule and a per-component public status page, uncommon for a routing service.
Three passthrough surfaces preserving upstream request shapes sit alongside two compatible conventions.
Separate mainland and overseas endpoints carry an identical catalogue and interface.
tradeoffs: Retention of prompts and outputs is undocumented, and the terms defer to a data policy that is not published anywhere reachable.
